test.summary: SPM – OKR – Manual updates visibility and behavior when toggle is OFF
test.description:
This test verifies manual updates visibility and behavior in OKR details when automated updates toggle is disabled.

Covered areas:

* Objective/KR Details page
* Status changes tab
* Toggle: {{Show automated updates}}
* Info panel ({{Last updated}})

Validation scope:

* Verifying manual updates are visible when toggle is ON
* Verifying manual updates are visible when toggle is OFF
* Verifying AUTO updates are hidden when toggle is OFF
* Verifying manual updates are not marked with {{API}} label
* Verifying manual updates are displayed correctly in {{Status changes}}
* Verifying manual updates are displayed correctly in {{Activity}}
* Verifying {{Last updated}} section displays latest manual update correctly

steps.action:
*Preconditions:*

Objective and Key Result are created and linked to the box

steps.data: boxName: TC-6251 SPM – OKR – Manual updates visibility and behavior when toggle is OFF
steps.result: Objective and Key result are displayed in Overview

steps.action: Open Key result in Detail page and navigate to status changes
steps.result:
Key result detail page is opened. *Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled. 

"Key result created" status update is displayed in the Status changes section.

steps.action: Click Update button and change status to "ON TRACK"
steps.result: Status is changed to ON TRACK

*Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled.

Status update is displayed correctly in the Status changes section.
Activity tab is opened. Key result creation activity is displayed with *NEW* label, correct status, progress and current value information.
Last updated field is visible under Status and displayed last updated date (DD/MM/YY)

steps.action: Navigate to tree dots button and click in Convert to Auto Key result
steps.result: Success, Key result was successfully converted message is displayed

*Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled.

AUTO update is displayed in the Status changes section and update author is shown as *OKRobot.*
Show automated updates toggle is disabled. Only manual updates are displayed in the Status changes section. AUTO updates are hidden.

Description:
This test verifies manual updates visibility and behavior in OKR details when automated updates toggle is disabled.

Covered areas:

* Objective/KR Details page
* Status changes tab
* Toggle: {{Show automated updates}}
* Info panel ({{Last updated}})

Validation scope:

* Verifying manual updates are visible when toggle is ON
* Verifying manual updates are visible when toggle is OFF
* Verifying AUTO updates are hidden when toggle is OFF
* Verifying manual updates are not marked with {{API}} label
* Verifying manual updates are displayed correctly in {{Status changes}}

Steps:
1. *Preconditions:*

Objective and Key Result are created and linked to the box
   Data: * Objective 1
* Key result 1
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName

   Expected: Objective and Key result are displayed in Overview
3. Open Key result in Detail page and navigate to status changes
   Expected: Key result detail page is opened. *Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled.

   Expected: *Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled.

10. Disable *Show automated updates* toggle
